selection_protocol: Deterministic stratification, three Nr3D and three unique Sr3D+ queries per scene. Nr3D covers spatial+attribute, spatial, and non-spatial language where available; Sr3D+ greedily diversifies official relation types. No result metric is used for selection.
ground_truth_scope: Target and anchor IDs come from official ReferIt3D Nr3D/Sr3D+ annotations. Expected boxes come from official ScanNet aggregation segments over the axis-aligned mesh. The semantic map also consumes these GT instances, so this is retrieval/grounding over an oracle GT object map, not semantic perception or predicted-box localization accuracy.

failure_label_contract.wrong_object: selected object_id differs from the verified target_id
failure_label_contract.wrong_relation: selected target fails the annotated target-anchor relation
failure_label_contract.wrong_view: selected representative view differs from the imported assignment
failure_label_contract.wrong_room_or_zone: selected room or zone differs from applicable GT
failure_label_contract.missing_gt: target, anchor, label, or box cannot be mapped
failure_label_contract.bad_bbox: prediction box is missing, invalid, or below the declared IoU threshold
failure_label_contract.unavailable_prediction: no executable canonical result was produced
